title: Count and Extract
goal: Find the actual character count and safely fetch a character.
hints: Rust strings use UTF-8 encoding. The `len()` method returns byte count rather than character count.
Indexing with brackets is not supported on `str` slices. Use an iterator method instead.
explanation: `chars().count()` counts Unicode scalar values. The `len()` and `bytes().count()` methods return byte lengths which fail on multi-byte characters like emojis. Standard bracket indexing causes compiler error E0608 because `str` cannot be indexed by integer. Calling `get(index)` causes error E0308 because `&str::get` expects a range. Using `chars().nth(index)` safely retrieves the character at the given index.
